title: Comments data API
description: The JSON sent and accepted by the Comments data API (comments/api/*) for API version 1, generated from @verbb/comments-core’s types.

ApiVersion.description: The version of the JSON format, sent as `apiVersion` and the `X-Comments-Api-Version` header.

AuthorData.description: The public author: no user ID, email or identity ID.

score.description: The signed-in author's net votes across their approved comments, while the site shows author scores. Null for a guest, or when scores are off.

interaction.description: Null on a placeholder, or when voting is off.

folded.description: Why the thread folds the comment away, as Comments 3 hid it: `reports` once it has the site's number of open reports, or `downvotes` once it has its number of downvotes. It's still public, and its moderation state is unchanged; a reader can open it. Null when it isn't folded.

custom.description: Public data a site adds with `Api::EVENT_DEFINE_COMMENT_DATA`.

viewer.description: Present only in private data: `viewer`'s `extraComments` and write responses.

moderation.description: Present only for moderators, in private data.

CommentPatchData.description: Part of one comment, for writes that change only that part.

CommentResponse.description: The `comment` read, for a link to a comment that isn't loaded: its root comment, with the replies leading down to the target first among their siblings.

ownerId.description: The element the comment's thread belongs to.

CommentState.description: `approved` and `placeholder` are the only states in public data. `pending`, `held` and `reported` arrive only through `viewer`, and `removed` and `spam` only in a `moderate` response, after which the comment leaves the thread. A comment waiting for a moderator is `held` to a moderator and `pending` to its author, so its author learns nothing about why it's waiting.

CommentViewerData.description: What the person asking may do with one comment. Never in public data.

reported.description: Whether this person has an open report on the comment.

custom.description: Private data a site adds with `Api::EVENT_DEFINE_VIEWER_DATA`.

html.description: Rich comments only. Sanitised on the server by Editor, and the only raw HTML a renderer inserts.

gifUrl.description: A GIF shown with the comment, chosen through GIPHY or from Comments 3.

gifWidth.description: The GIF's size, when it's known, so the page can make room for it before it loads.

uid.description: Null until the conversation's first comment.

closedNotice.description: The notice shown on a closed conversation.

commentCount.description: Approved comments in the whole conversation, replies included.

followAvailable.description: Whether following by email is offered here.

showAvatars.description: False when the site's **Show Avatar** setting is off, so the thread draws no avatars.

CreateResponse.description: A repeat of a write's `operationId` within ten minutes returns the first result with `replayed: true` instead of acting twice. Every write has an `announcement` for the live region, which is null over GraphQL.

conversation.description: Null over GraphQL, where the store counts the change itself.

announcement.description: A sentence for the live region, such as "Comment submitted for moderation."

CsrfData.description: Craft's CSRF parameter, sent back on writes as the `X-CSRF-Token` header.

timeAgo.description: The relative time in the site's language.

document.description: Editor's document JSON, for rich comments.

EditFileData.description: A file an edited comment already has, in an Assets field's value.

EditorData.description: The editor's public definition, the same for everyone.

EditorOptionsData.description: Editor's options for the person asking, such as their mention and upload endpoints.

EditResponse.description: The `edit` read, for the comment's author. Includes collected-only field values.

fields.description: Values keyed by handle, for the fields the comment was posted with, in the shape a submission sends; a file field's is a list of `EditFileData`, whose IDs keep the files when sent back.
Exactly the fields the comment was posted with, minus any since turned Off, to draw instead of `viewer`'s.

gifs.description: GIF search, as on `viewer`'s editor, so an edit can change or add a GIF.

category.description: A broad group, such as `validation` or `protection`, for handling a code a client doesn't know.

message.description: A translated sentence for the visitor.

recoverable.description: Whether trying again (after a refresh or a wait) can succeed.

retryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before trying again, for `rate_limited`.

FieldInputType.description: The input a custom field uses on the site. `custom` needs a field override in JavaScript.

FieldPlacement.description: Where a shown custom field appears: after the date, or in a labelled list under the text.

FieldValueData.description: One shown custom field value. Collected-only values never appear in public data.

value.description: The raw value: a string, number, `YYYY-MM-DD` (or an ISO 8601 date and time), an option's value or a list of them, true or false, or for files a list of `FileValueData`. For `url`, the address only when it's `http` or `https`, and null otherwise, with the address in `text`.

FileValueData.description: A file in a shown Assets field.

url.description: Null for a volume without public URLs.

FoldReason.description: Why a comment is folded away.

outcome.description: `confirming` when a guest must confirm their address first.

FormFieldData.description: A custom field this person may fill in, after conditions and the replies rule.

public.description: Whether the value is shown publicly on the comment, which matters to the person filling it in.

placement.description: Where a shown field's value appears, or null for a field that's only collected.

formPosition.description: Where the field goes in the form: `above` the text, for a field placed before the Comment element in the Comment field layout, such as a rating, or `below` it. Missing means below.

width.description: The width set in the Comment field layout, as a percentage of the form: 25, 50, 75 or 100. Missing means 100.

accept.description: Assets fields only: the extensions taken, with their dots, such as `.jpg`.

maxFiles.description: Assets fields only: null for no limit.

maxSize.description: Assets fields only: the largest file, in bytes.

meta.description: Anything else the field type's description gives, for the site's own field override.

GifData.description: A comment's GIF: its address as GIPHY gave it, and its size when known.

GifInput.description: A GIF to post with a comment, by the address GIPHY gave it. On an update, leaving `gif` out keeps the comment's GIF, and `null` removes it.

GifsData.description: What the browser needs to search GIPHY itself, as GIPHY's terms require. The key is the site's GIPHY key, which GIPHY treats as public for a website; `rating` and `limit` go to GIPHY with each search.

InteractionMode.description: `like` counts upvotes only, `updown` counts both directions, and `none` turns voting off.

comment.description: The comment with `moderation`. A `removed` or `spam` state means it has left the thread.

ModerationData.description: A moderator's view of a held or reported comment. Never in public data.

text.description: Can be empty when the comment is only a GIF.

ProtectionChallengeData.description: One challenge in a preparation. This and the two types after it are Protect's own (`ChallengeManifest`, `BrowserManifest` and `Evidence` in `@verbb/protect`), written out so core's types need neither Protect's nor the DOM's; a test keeps them the same.

ProtectionData.description: A Protect preparation for one form, single-use.

expiresAt.description: Unix seconds, on the server's clock.

ProtectionEvidenceData.description: What a form sends back for a preparation, from Protect's `prepare()`.

issuedAt.description: Unix seconds, on the server's clock.

ProtectionResponse.description: The `protection` read, for someone about to write: a fresh preparation, or null when the site doesn't use protection here, and the CSRF token, since this is where a guest's session starts.

RemovedCommentData.description: What's left of a comment a moderator removed.

count.description: Every approved reply, loaded or not.

items.description: A preview, three by default, nested up to four levels in one response.

next.description: The cursor for the rest, through `replies`.

RepliesResponse.description: The `replies` read: a page of approved replies to one comment, with `next` for the page after.

withdraw.description: Withdraws this person's open report instead.

module.description: Editor's own module, loaded only when someone starts writing.

SessionResponse.description: The `session` read: who's signed in and the CSRF token, starting a guest's session. A tier 3 guest's token arrives in the `X-Comments-Session` header. `csrf` is null for tier 3, whose requests carry no cookies.

StructuredDataResponse.description: The `structured-data` read: the schema.org JSON-LD object for the comments.

ThreadResponse.description: The `thread` read: public data, the same for every visitor.

threadVersion.description: A stamp of the public data this was built from. When the `viewer` read's `threadVersion` differs, a cache served an older thread, such as just after the visitor's own comment.

moderationState.description: An edit can send a comment back for approval.

UploadedFileData.description: A file uploaded for an Assets field, waiting to be posted with a comment.

hasSession.description: False in the slim answer for a browser Comments doesn't recognise.

badges.description: The badges this person's comments carry here, in the same shape as an author's.

ViewerEditorData.description: The editor's private half, for the person asking.

protection.description: Null for a guest who hasn't started writing, or when the site doesn't use protection.

gifs.description: GIF search through GIPHY, or null when it's off or this person can't comment.

ViewerResponse.description: The `viewer` read: everything personal for the window a `thread` or `replies` read loaded.

threadVersion.description: The current public data's stamp, to compare with the drawn thread's `threadVersion`.

extraComments.description: Comments the public data leaves out but this person may see: their own pending ones, and held or reported ones for moderators.

csrf.description: Null in the slim answer for a guest with no session.

custom.description: Private data a site adds with `Api::EVENT_DEFINE_VIEWER_DATA`.

VoteRequest.description: Sets the vote rather than toggling it, so a repeat is harmless. `null` clears it.
